items.title: Weapons Expansion SCI-FI
items.creator: Shapescape
items.description:
Craft yourself a wide variety of new SCI-FI weapons in Weapons Expansion SCI-FI! Laser swords, laser battle axes or perhaps a plasma beamer? Fight some aliens or cruise your speeder through the sky! Enhance your survival or PvP experience with this futuristic weapons expansion! 

+ 70+ new weapon options!
+ Laser blasters!
+ Speeders
+ Custom Animations!
+ All craftable!

items.title: Magnet Mobs
items.creator: Diluvian
items.description:
Woosh! This crazy scientist made me a mob magnet, adventure yourself as a magnet too!

+ Attract items, tridents, fishs and... Creepers???
+ Recommendation: Don't use your bow.

items.title: Flower Aesthetic HD Skin Pack
items.creator: CupcakeBrianna
items.description:
Roam through the field of flowers in these beautiful and stylish floral outfits. Inspired by cottage core aesthetic, these teens will brighten your day and bring a relaxing tone to your roleplay playthrough.

+ 12 HD skins
+ By CupcakeBrianna

items.title: Pilot Dreams
items.creator: Cleverlike
items.description: Do you dream of being a pilot and flying millionaires from cities to tropical islands? Maybe you'll fly a jumbo jet or a stunt plane! Maybe you'll deliver precious cargo, like bringing rescued wild animals to the zoo. Whatever you dream, you can achieve!

items.title: LLAMAS!
items.creator: Diveblocks
items.description: Become one of the best mobs in Minecraft with this new llama expansion skin pack! Stand out among your friends in unique llama-suits. Enjoy llamas as a creeper, a Nether hunter, a desert adventurer or even as a cave explorer!

items.title: Rich Legends
items.creator: Pickaxe Studios
items.description:
These multimillionaires are rich legends! Want to look rich? These skins are perfect for you.

- Millionaire skins
- Teen fashion

By: Pickaxe Studios

items.title: Millionaire Mansion
items.creator: Pickaxe Studios
items.description:
You are a millionaire. Enjoy being super rich with this $10,000,000 mansion with super cars. 

- Cars included
- Huge millionaire mansion world

items.title: Witch Hunters
items.creator: Podcrash
items.description:
The world is full of mystery. The land is polluted by sinister magic and the creatures of the night, but fear not! We are Witch Hunters! We will eradicate the plight of magic from these dark lands. Join us on the quest to reclaim the world for mankind!

+ 20 unique role-playing skins
+ Medieval, adventurous attire!

items.title: Deep Sea
items.creator: Podcrash
items.description:
There are sea creatures among us! The ocean is deep and full of mystery. No need to be scared of its depths! Put on your flippers and swim around underneath the surface. Find a new civilization of warriors, protectors, and creatures!

+ 12 skins
+ 1 free skin

items.title: Punk Style
items.creator: Podcrash
items.description:
Who’s ready to rock? With our latest skin pack Punk Style, it’s time to show everyone who you are! Whether you’re looking for the perfect modern teen outfit to rave with, or if you simply want to look the best in your school, we have a trending outfit that is perfect for you! 

- 12 modern punk teen skins
- Perfect for roleplay!

items.title: Mega Block Parkour 3
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description: Parkour through the sky in Mega Block Parkour 3! This is a parkour course that gets increasingly challenging as you navigate giant block-themed levels. Practice your parkour on this map or see how fast you can beat it and prove you're a true master!

items.title: Rich Blocks
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
You’re rich and famous! It’s time to grab some of the latest styles and dress up in the block that suits your personality the best! Do you feel like shining bright like a diamond or exploding like TNT? Whichever you feel like, we have an outfit for you!

- 10 unique skins
- by Bluend Studios

items.title: Pirates
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
Ahoy! It is time to sail the endless seas with your friends and find treasures on mysterious islands! Get these unique pirate skins and hit the seas now. Your ship is ready to set sail on your command!

+ Includes 12 fearless pirate skins
+ 1 free skin
+ Perfect for roleplay
+ Great for teens
+ By Mirevon Studios

items.title: Corrupted Mobs
items.creator: Blu Shutter Bug
items.description:
Just a beautiful day when all of a sudden you see a glitch in the world! These mobs don't look like the regular mobs you are used to seeing!? What in the world is going on? Well, while you investigate further check out these corrupted mob skins!

- 6 skins
- By: Blu Shutter Bug

items.title: Darklings
items.creator: Blu Shutter Bug
items.description:
The Darklings come out on a full moon night. They rise to roam and skulk where light does not. They are Darklings after all, and it is only fitting that they keep to the shadows . Be careful now, lest you want to find a nebulous creature or worse... join them.

- 10 skins
- By: Blu Shutter Bug

items.title: Spring Time Teens
items.creator: Blu Shutter Bug
items.description:
Spring time is teen time! Become a flowery happy go lucky adorable nature loving individual! These skins are a cute and colorful addition to your spring collection.

- 9 skins
- By: Twin B Studios

items.title: Animals!
items.creator: Entity Builds
items.description:
What’s your spirit animal? Are you a terrifying tiger, a playful panda, a silly sheep, a crazy cow, or something else? Find out what it’s like to rule the jungle, dominate the icy tundra, swim from coast to coast, or cause chaos with your friendly buddies! Become your favorite creature with the Animals! skin pack! 

~Roleplay as a variety of different mobs

items.title: Black And White 3
items.creator: Impulse
items.description:
See your world through greyscale with these trendy black & white outfits! Show off your style and look amazing!

+ 14 custom skins for you to choose from!
+ A skin for every person!
+ Collect all black & white skin packs!

items.title: Neon Hair 2
items.creator: Blockception
items.description:
Want radiant colors in your hair? With these skins, you can have the hair of your dreams! Put bright colors like aqua, pink, and blue in your hair and look fabulous!

+ 12 custom skins for you to choose from!
+ Look trendy and stylish in-game!
+ Collect all colorful hair skins!

items.title: Fashion Ores Teens
items.creator: UnderBlocks Studios
items.description:
Ores are the new trend!

+11 skins
by UnderBlocks

items.title: Adventure Texture Pack
items.creator: Blockception
items.description:
Add a more natural and earthy feel to your game with this detailed and unique resource pack! Build beautiful structures with these custom blocks and admire the various creatures and mobs. This pack will add color and life to your game!

+ Beautifully crafted textures with every block!
+ Custom mob and villager looks!
+ Upgrade your game with this amazing resource pack!

items.title: Runway Trends: Spring '21
items.creator: G2Crafted
items.description:
Walk down the runway in this season's top designer trends. Roleplay with your friends by creating your own fashion week with styles from New York, Milan, London and Paris. Every day is a fashion show, now make Minecraft your runway. 

- 10 skins
- 1 free skin included
- Created by G2Crafted

items.title: Teen Fashion Buddies
items.creator: In Mine
items.description:
Fashion buddies is a teen fashionable skins tailored for you. Play as a modern teenager and stun your friends with your amazing look.

+ Teen fashion
+ Luxury look
+ Anime
+ 1 free skin
+ By In Mine

items.title: Anime Trendy Teens
items.creator: In Mine
items.description:
The squad of buddies called anime trendy teens is now yours to show your unique fashion taste. Choose your style and join the game as an anime teen character with an outstanding look.

+ Anime
+ Teens fashion
+ 1 free skin
+ By In Mine
